title: UCOS Contract — Error Model Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema for the error model of a contract operation. Transport-neutral and implementation-neutral. Error shapes are OPTIONAL because UCOS-CONTRACT-CAT-001 defines NO error model at the boundary level; absence is represented explicitly via declared:false, never invented.

declared.description: true when a concrete error model is defined; false when the catalog defines none (the case for API-018/027).

errors.description: OPTIONAL set of declared error conditions. Empty/absent when the catalog defines none.

code.description: Stable, transport-neutral error code (NOT an HTTP status).

$comment: Additive evolution only: future versions may add OPTIONAL properties but MUST NOT remove or repurpose existing ones. No implementation-specific fields (no HTTP status codes, no framework error types).
